title: PM-USP CSSS 2026–27 — Eligibility, Renewal, Deadline & Information Verification Audit
researchQuestion: What should a college or university student verify before applying for or renewing the PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for Academic Year 2026–27?
objective: Analyze official Government of India scholarship portal pages, scheme guidelines, FAQs and historical documents to identify the latest available eligibility conditions, academic requirements, income conditions, scholarship amounts, renewal criteria, application deadlines, verification timelines, documentation requirements and application procedures. Compare information across the sources to identify potential information gaps, possible conflicting statements, outdated provisions and unanswered questions. Generate an evidence-backed verification checklist that helps students understand what must be confirmed before applying or renewing their scholarship.
authorityOrOrganization: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
executiveSummary: Multi-source evidence analysis completed across 5 Government of India scholarship documents. Critical finding: A significant deadline discrepancy was detected between the National Scholarship Portal's All-Scholarships scheme directory (specifying a renewal closing date of 30 November 2026) and the Students Announcement notice desk (specifying 31 October 2026). Multiple information gaps were identified regarding the publication of official 2026–27 board cut-off percentiles and exact defective application re-verification windows.

sources.organization: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
sources.extractedText: PRADHAN MANTRI UCHCHATAR SHIKSHA PROTSAHAN (PM-USP) YOJANA GUIDELINES FOR THE COMPONENT SCHEME – CENTRAL SECTOR SCHEME OF SCHOLARSHIP FOR COLLEGE AND UNIVERSITY STUDENTS (PM-USP CSSS) (Applicable for academic year 2022-23 onwards). 1. Objective: To provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections. 2. Allocation: 82,000 fresh scholarships per annum (41,000 for boys and 41,000 for girls) allocated state-wise based on population in age group 18-25. 3. Eligibility: Students above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the particular Board of Examination in Class XII. Pursuing regular courses from recognized colleges/institutions. Gross parental/family income ceiling is Rs. 4.5 lakh per annum. Income certificate required from fresh applicants only once. 4. Rate of Scholarship: Rs. 12,000/- per annum at Graduation level for first three years. Rs. 20,000/- per annum at Post Graduation level. For 5 year integrated courses Rs. 20,000/- per annum in 4th and 5th year. 5. Renewal Criteria: Student must secure at least 50% marks in annual examination and minimum 75% attendance. Must maintain good discipline and not indulge in ragging. 6. Restrictions: Student availing scholarship under this scheme shall not avail any other scholarship scheme including State run scholarship/fee waiver.

sources.title: PM-USP CSSS Official Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ_DOHE_CSSS.pdf)
sources.organization: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
sources.extractedText: Government of India Ministry of Education Department of Higher Education (Scholarship Division). PM-USP CSSS FAQs 2025-26. Q1: Is One Time Registration (OTR) mandatory? Yes, OTR is mandatory for applying on NSP from AY 2024-25 onwards. Q2: Can a student apply for renewal if he/she changed college? Yes, student can change college in renewal application subject to verification by new institute. Q3: What documents are required for renewal? Student must upload marksheet showing minimum 50% marks and institute attendance verification certifying minimum 75% attendance. Q4: Is fresh income certificate required for renewal? No, income certificate is required only at the time of fresh application. Q5: How is scholarship disbursed? Exclusively through Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

conflicts.aspect: PM-USP CSSS Application & Renewal Closing Deadlines
conflicts.label: POTENTIAL DEADLINE DISCREPANCY — REQUIRES OFFICIAL CONFIRMATION
conflicts.explanation: The National Scholarship Portal's Scheme Listing (All-Scholarships) indicates that Student Applications for Renewal are open until 30 November 2026, whereas the general Students Announcement notice desk states a closing date of 31 October 2026. This creates a critical risk that applicants relying on the 30 November date could find the portal closed if the 31 October announcement is enforced.
